contributions.anchor: BOX B 'Contributions Received this Period' (3195.65) on the SUMMARY PAGE, which on this modern_boxAF filing is the LAST page (p4, located by its printed heading). ⚠ BOX B IS THE ONLY ANCHOR THAT EXISTS FOR THIS SIDE: the filer left BOTH of Schedule A's printed footers - 'Subtotal for this page' and 'Total Contributions Received (Sum of all Schedule A pages in this report)' - COMPLETELY BLANK, so there is no page-scope figure to gate against and none was synthesized
contributions.detail: 2 Schedule A rows sum to 500 + 2695.55 = 3,195.55 against Box B's 3,195.65 - a shortfall of 0.10, RETAINED VERBATIM. The trace: BOTH figures are machine-set type on a born-digital fillable form, escalated to 1600 dpi and 800 dpi crops respectively, and both are unambiguous - the row cell reads '2695.55' and Box B reads '3195.65'. 500 + 2695.65 would equal Box B exactly, so the discrepancy is a single typed digit inside the filer's own document; but the ROW is the document's own statement of that transaction and it is NOT nudged to make the box close (CHUNK_BRIEF section 3). Screening done first: the grid is FULLY BOXED and every one of its 15 cells was rendered in a single 500 dpi column crop - rows 3 to 15 are empty ruled cells, so trap H3 (two entries in one row) and trap F1.5 (a ledger continuing below the grid) are both excluded, and there is no third entry hiding anywhere. Correlated-error screen: the filer's OTHER 2020 filing in this chunk (key 55b040ff) closes to the cent on both sides, so this is a one-off, not a habit. Box C 'Contributions Received Year to Date' prints 12592.15 and is NEVER summed as an increment.

expenditures.anchor: BOX D 'Expenditures Made this Period' (3325.19) on the p4 Summary Page. As on Schedule A, the filer left BOTH of Schedule B's printed footers blank, so Box D is the only anchor this side has
expenditures.detail: 4 Schedule B rows sum to 654.99 + 545 + 2050.20 + 75.00 = 3,325.19 exactly = Box D. Box E (Year to Date) prints 12592.15 and is never summed. The cover ladder is internally consistent up to Box F: Box A 129.54 + Box B 3195.65 = Box F 3325.19 as printed.

itemized.in_kind_convention: not applicable on this filing - tested both ways per ADDENDUM G1 with the same result: the v.4.20 form prints no in-kind column, no row is marked in-kind, and no contribution is mirrored by an equal offsetting expenditure. itemized.escalation_note: Two cells escalated because the contribution side does not close: Schedule A row 2's amount (1600 dpi tight crop - rendered '2695.55' in clean machine type, no ambiguity) and summary Box B (800 dpi - rendered '3195.65', also machine type). Escalation resolves legibility, never truth: both figures are certain, so the 0.10 is a fact about the filer's own typed document and neither cell was changed.

itemized.notes: Andrea Allen, Utah County RECORDER, 2020 cycle - the SECOND of two Allen filings in this chunk. ⚠ THE TWO ARE NOT THE SAME REPORT AND WERE NOT MERGED. This one is 'Seven days preceding the General Election', report date 10-26-20, Box A 129.54 / Box B 3195.65 / Box D 3325.19, with two contribution rows and four expenditure rows; key 55b040ff is 'Seven days preceding the Primary Election', report date 6/23/20, Box A 0 / Box B 9396.50 / Box D 9266.96, with thirteen and fifteen rows. Different report type, different dates, different figures, disjoint row sets - two distinct reports by one filer in one cycle, each transcribed on its own terms. (Observation only, used as no gate: this report's Box A 129.54 is the other report's balance at close, and its Box C/E year-to-date figures are consistent with the two periods being additive - noted because it confirms they are sequential reports, NOT because any figure was differenced across covers, which the contract forbids.) ⚠ THE FILENAME IS MISLEADING: the county's channel names the file '2020_Andrea-4-15-22-General_Redacted.pdf', embedding a '4-15-22' that appears nowhere on the page - the page face carries 10-26-20 throughout. The page face governs. FORM: modern_boxAF v. 4.20, born-digital fillable, four pages - p1 cover / p2 Schedule A / p3 Schedule B / p4 SUMMARY PAGE (LAST, located by heading); boxes A / B / C / D / E / F with an UNLETTERED 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' box; no checklist decoy; the 'Page' field is blank on every page, so the filing carries no foliation. TWO DOCUMENT PROPERTIES WORTH RECORDING: (1) BOTH SCHEDULES HAVE THEIR PRINTED FOOTERS LEFT ENTIRELY BLANK - no page subtotal and no cycle total on either sheet - so each side has exactly ONE anchor, the summary box, and there is no second independent figure to cross-check; that is a real narrowing of the evidence and it is stated rather than papered over. (2) A FILER LADDER ERROR, transcribed as printed and NOT adjudicated: the 'Balance at Close of Reporting Period (Box F - Box D)' box is filled in as 3325.19, the same figure as Box F and Box D, where the form's own formula gives 3325.19 - 3325.19 = 0. Nothing was recomputed. REDACTION is inconsistent WITHIN this one page: Schedule A row 1's full address is published in the clear while row 2's is entirely blacked out, and the cover's signature is blacked out. Expenditures reconcile EXACTLY on Box D; contributions carry a 0.10 typed-digit delta, retained verbatim.
